    Where it is: IT shelf = stock held by IT; Custodian = signed to a named person (IT register holder, or the site custodian in the count); Admin / department = held by a department (Finance); Location = a floor, office or partner facility with no named person; For sale = old items awaiting sale on the 5th floor. When an item is in both the IT register and the site count, the site from the count is used as its location and the IT register holder as its custodian.

        Non-IT disposal list

        How this was put together. The active register is IT Inventory V03, which already carries the cleaned-up holder names listed on its Owner Changes sheet; both spreadsheets were otherwise read as-is. Funder and supplier names spelt in different ways were merged (for example “Unicef” and “UNICEF”, or five spellings of Step Forward). Owners are grouped into custody types; the Arabic entry for the health units of the Youth Role project in Sohag and Assiut is shown as a partner facility. Blank, “0” and “*” values are shown as “Not recorded”. No items were matched between the two registers: their tag numbers and serials do not overlap. All items on the old IT items list, and IT items recorded as broken in the site count, are treated as for sale; stolen items are listed for write-off. From the FY2026 property count, only IT-related items were taken (computers, printers and copiers, network and phones, CCTV, audio-visual, and the Fab Lab’s 3D printer, laser cutter and plotter); they were matched to the IT register by serial number. The main warehouse count held no IT items.

        Prepared by the IT Unit for the Board and CEO.
